chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Barqī, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from al-Sakūnī, from Jaʿfar, from his father, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:
Regarding a woman who commits zina before the marriage is consummated, he said: “They are to be separated, and there is no dowry for her, because the occurrence came from her side.”

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman concerned in the legal ruling
key_terms.يُدْخَلَ بِهَا: the marriage is consummated with her

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman commits zina before the marriage is consummated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who commits zina before consummation of the marriage. It states that the spouses are to be separated and that she is not entitled to the dowry, since the cause of the annulment originated from her side.
